# BTicino C300X Integration v1.9.9

## 2026-11-02

This release includes all changes from the withdrawn v1.9.8 release.

## Upgrade

- Requires Home Assistant `2026.7.0` or newer. Automated validation targets
  `2026.7.0` and `2026.10.0`; HA 2026.5 and 2026.6 are no longer supported.
- Includes freshly built native agent `1.9.9` and all matching GUI components.
  Update the agent and core QML hook together, then reload the C300X GUI.
  Updating only the Home Assistant integration does not activate device fixes.
- Agent self-updates use existing maintenance access without extra SSH credentials.

## Fixed

- Synchronize ringer mute/unmute with the GUI's saved audio state through the
  same AudioState operations as the device button (#65). Require GUI confirmation
  and device readback; fail explicitly when the GUI is unavailable. Include all
  required GUI components in agent self-updates. Ringer operation is confirmed
  on the test device.
- Correct the core call-end notification from port 8092 to the default UI port
  8090. Reapplying the core patch upgrades old hooks while preserving backups.

## Added

- Optional verified HTTPS for event and display callbacks through an explicit
  HTTPS callback base URL override. Requires an updated agent. HTTP does not
  initialize TLS. Changing HTTP/HTTPS modes restarts only the agent, deferred
  while media is active. HTTPS adds TLS work on the device, verifies certificate
  chains and hostnames, and never falls back to HTTP. HTTPS operation is confirmed
  on the test device. Thanks to @Minims for the original contribution in #61,
  adapted in #71.

## Changed

- Support Home Assistant 2026.10 using Probatio on HA 2026.9+ and Voluptuous on
  older supported versions, including the camera API changes.
- Prepare Marketplace metadata and installation documentation. Use the public
  DeviceInfo constructor for forward compatibility and document API maintenance.
- Bundle routine Actions and Python tool updates quarterly, with one open PR per
  area, while keeping security updates independent. Align dependency manifests,
  CI and the supported HA minimum; remove the unused dependency input that caused
  transitive pin churn.
- Disable the unused AnyIO pytest plugin instead of filtering its deprecation
  warning or overriding Home Assistant's dependencies.
- Remove the ineffective on-demand teardown settle window introduced in 1.9.7,
  which delayed reconnects by up to 8 seconds. SIP-setup failure reasons remain
  available.
- Tear on-demand sessions down by removing only the agent's own BT-AV UDP clients
  instead of issuing a global pipeline stop. Distinguish a NACK from a missing
  ACK in removal logs; a NACK can occur after SIP BYE removed the pipeline.
- Offer only PCMU in on-demand SDP when the configured device codec is PCMU (#55).
- Preserve separate SIP messages received together over TCP, including a final
  INVITE response following `100 Trying`. Reassemble fragmented messages within
  a bounded deadline and reject incomplete or invalid frames.

## Known Limitations

- **PCMU on-demand device reboots (#55) remain unresolved.** The media changes
  are not a confirmed reboot fix; use `speex` to avoid the known PCMU failure.

## Release Assets

- One HACS installation archive with native agent and QML components, plus
  `SHA256SUMS`, `build-metadata.json` and an SPDX 2.3 SBOM.
- The release workflow generates and verifies SLSA provenance and SBOM
  attestations against this tag and its source commit before publication.
